name: Applegate Naturals Gluten-Free Chicken Breast Tenders
whyItWorks: Whole white meat chicken breast tenders coated in a light, gluten-free rice and corn flour crust. They bake golden and crispy in the oven with far less grease than fast-food fried tenders and zero wheat roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake at 425°F for 18–20 minutes until crispy. Dip in honey mustard or low-FODMAP ketchup.
watchOuts: Bake in oven or air fryer; do not deep fry.
